step_by_step_reasoning:
The architecture depicts National Australia Bank's (NAB) automated compliance and deployment platform ('Deputy').
1. Service teams running pipelines in Non-Prod accounts send build events and API calls to Kong running on ECS.
2. ECS proxies the requests to Lambda functions.
3. Lambda captures build events/evidence and persists them in DynamoDB.
4. When teams call the promotion API, Lambda retrieves evidence from DynamoDB and checks it against defined compliance rules and controls stored in RDS PostgreSQL.
5. Upon successful validation, Lambda sends a notification via SNS to trigger cross-account artifact copy and deployment in PROD.

graph.name: NAB Automated Compliance and Deployment Platform
graph.notes: Transcribed architecture of NAB's automated compliance validation and promotion platform using ECS (Kong), Lambda, DynamoDB, RDS PostgreSQL, and SNS.

nodes.name: SERVICE TEAMS
nodes.notes: NAB service teams executing build pipelines in non-production environments.

nodes.name: ECS
nodes.notes: Runs Kong API gateway on Amazon ECS to expose endpoints for build events and promotion API calls.

nodes.name: LAMBDA x25
nodes.notes: Executes logic for capturing pipeline events, running compliance assessments, and invoking promotion flows.

nodes.name: DYNAMODB
nodes.notes: Stores build event evidence and telemetry key-value pairs from pipeline builds.

nodes.name: RDS POSTGRESQL
nodes.notes: Stores relational compliance standards, control definitions, and team metadata.

nodes.name: SNS
nodes.notes: Publishes promotion notifications across accounts to trigger automated artifact copying and deployment into PROD.

edges.notes: Service teams send build events and API calls from non-prod pipelines to Kong API gateway on ECS.
Kong routes requests to AWS Lambda.
Lambda stores build evidence and pipeline event data in DynamoDB.
Service team sends promotion request API call.
Kong routes promotion API call to Lambda compliance assessment engine.
Lambda reads build evidence for the workload from DynamoDB.
Lambda compares build evidence against compliance rules and standards stored in RDS PostgreSQL.
Upon passing compliance assessment, Lambda publishes promotion event to SNS to trigger cross-account artifact copy to PROD.
